title: 第619章 成功摆脱亡灵大军的追击暴打圣天第618章 坑货圣灵被亡灵大军追杀
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 荒芜平原上，两道身影化作流光疯狂逃窜。
身后是黑压压的亡灵大军，如同潮水一般席卷而来。
林轩一边飞一边骂，嘴里各种脏话层出不穷。
身后的圣天自知理亏，虽然不敢还嘴，但依旧死皮赖脸地跟在他身后，怎么甩都甩不掉。
“小子，快想想办法，它们要追上来了。”圣天回头看了一眼，吓得毛发都竖了起来。
只见亡灵大军中，几个体型格外高大、周身缠绕着浓郁黑色死气的身影正在以极快的速度拉近距离。
它们那股死亡气息，凝练得几乎要化作实质。
林轩也感觉到了身后的压迫感越来越强。
他回头瞥了一眼，心中顿时一沉。
那几道身影散发的气息，毫无疑问是仙王层次的气息。
一个仙王层次的强者，哪怕只是最低级的仙王，也足以轻松碾压成百上千的天仙修士。
那是质的差距，是修炼一途的第三次跃迁和质变。
这是一道无法逾越的鸿沟，阻挡了不知道多少修士，让其终生无法踏入仙王层次。
更别说对方还不止一个仙王层次的亡灵，甚至后面还有一大群亡灵层次的大军。
这等阵容，别说他了和圣天两个了，就是再来百个也对付不了这么多亡灵啊。
“操，仙王层次的亡灵速度太快了！”林轩脸色大变。
他虽然能够越级战斗，可以凭借地仙七重天，就击败修为天仙四重天但实力堪比一般天仙九重天的叶云山，甚至面对实力达到天仙巅峰的也丝毫不虚。
但仙王和天仙之间的差距，比天仙和凡人之间的差距还要大得多。
那是真正意义上的质变，跨入仙王境之后，修士体内的仙力会经历一次脱胎换骨的蜕变，并结合自身大道凝聚出仙王特有的“大道之种”，举手投足间都能引动大道法则。
到了这等层次，已经和之前仅仅徒有大道其形不一样了，而是每一次攻击都带着一丝大道的本质，攻击威力相比之前会成几何倍增加。
而且仙王层次，已经开始初步接触至高大道之一的时间大道，掌握部分时间之力，能正式涉足时间长河。
从此岁月不加其身，只要不出意外，仙王将永世长存，与天地齐寿。
因此哪怕林轩有混沌剑体，在妖孽，也绝对不可能在现在地仙八重天这个阶段，战胜仙王级别的存在。
哪怕这些亡灵没啥灵智，很多手段不会用，实力相比正常仙王会弱很多，但也不是如今的林轩能对付的。
“怎么办怎么办……”
圣天此刻也是急得直跳脚，“小子你有没有办法啊？本圣可不想刚苏醒不久就死在这里。”
“你别吵，我在想。”林轩一边飞一边飞速思考。
他的大脑在疯狂运转，思考着所有可能的应对方案。
打是肯定打不过的，哪怕他手段尽出，也不可能和仙王级别的存在正面对抗。
而这样逃也不是办法，那几个仙王层次的亡灵速度太快了，继续这样下去，迟早会被追上。
最终思索一番，林轩发现除了动用底牌，好像也是没啥办法了。
林轩很无奈，如果可以，他真的不想将底牌浪费在这些亡灵身上。
但如今也没办法了，甩掉这些亡灵大军要紧。
他脑海中，已经决定动用之前在那天仙孙家拍卖会上，捡漏拍下来的那颗珠子。
他知道那颗珠子里面封印着一道，堪比仙王七重天强者全力一击的攻击。
帮助他逃走应该是没问题的……
下一刻，林轩手中凭空多出了一颗鸡蛋大小的黑色珠子。
content_en:
On the desolate plain, two figures turned into streams of light and fled crazily.
Behind him was the black army of undead, sweeping in like a tide.
Lin Xuan cursed while flying, with all kinds of swear words coming out of his mouth in an endless stream.
Shengtian behind him knew that he was wrong. Although he did not dare to talk back, he still followed him shamelessly, unable to get rid of him no matter how hard he tried.
"Boy, think of a way quickly, they are going to catch up." Shengtian looked back and his hair stood up in fear.
Among the undead army, several figures with extremely tall bodies and thick black death aura were seen closing the distance at extremely fast speeds.
Their aura of death is so condensed that it almost turns into substance.
Lin Xuan also felt the pressure behind him getting stronger and stronger.
He glanced back and his heart suddenly sank.
The aura exuded by those figures was undoubtedly the aura of the Immortal King level.
A strong person at the Immortal King level, even the lowest Immortal King, is enough to easily crush hundreds or thousands of Celestial Immortal cultivators.
That is a qualitative gap, the third leap and qualitative change in the journey of cultivation.
This is an insurmountable gap that blocks countless monks from reaching the Immortal King level for the rest of their lives.
Not to mention that the opponent has more than one Immortal King level undead, and there is even a large army of undead levels behind him.
This kind of lineup, let alone him and Shengtian, even if there are hundreds more, they can't deal with so many undead.
"Fuck, the undead at the Immortal King level are too fast!" Lin Xuan's face changed drastically.
Although he can fight beyond the level, he can defeat Ye Yunshan, who has cultivated to the fourth level of Celestial Immortal but is comparable to the ninth level of ordinary Celestial Immortal, by relying on the seventh level of Earth Immortal. Even facing those who have reached the peak of Celestial Immortal, he is not weak at all.
But the gap between the Immortal King and the Celestial Beings is much wider than the gap between the Celestial Beings and mortals.
That is a qualitative change in the true sense. After entering the realm of the Immortal King, the immortal power in the monk's body will undergo a completely reborn transformation, and combined with his own avenue, he will condense the unique "seed of the avenue" of the Immortal King, and he can trigger the laws of the avenue with every move he makes.
At this level, it is no longer the same as before with only the form of the avenue. Instead, every attack carries a trace of the essence of the avenue, and the power of the attack will increase geometrically compared to before.
Moreover, at the level of the Immortal King, he has begun to have initial contact with the Avenue of Time, one of the highest avenues. He has mastered part of the power of time and can officially enter the river of time.
From now on, time will not add to his body, and as long as nothing unexpected happens, the Immortal King will live forever and live as long as heaven and earth.
Therefore, even if Lin Xuan has the Chaos Sword Body, it is absolutely impossible for the monster to defeat an existence at the level of the Immortal King at the current eighth level of the Earth Immortal.
Even though these undead souls have little intelligence, cannot use many methods, and are much weaker than normal immortal kings, they are still not something that Lin Xuan can deal with today.
"What to do, what to do..."
Shengtian was also jumping up and down anxiously at this moment, "Boy, is there anything you can do? I don't want to die here soon after I wake up."
"Don't make any noise, I'm thinking." Lin Xuan was thinking quickly as he flew.
His brain was running wildly, thinking of all possible responses.
He would definitely not be able to defeat him. Even if he tried his best, he would still not be able to confront an Immortal King level head-on.
And escaping like this is not an option. Those undead at the Immortal King level are too fast. If they continue like this, they will be caught up sooner or later.
After thinking about it for a while, Lin Xuan found that there seemed to be nothing he could do except using his trump card.
Lin Xuan was helpless. If possible, he really didn't want to waste his cards on these undead.
But now there is nothing we can do, it is important to get rid of these undead army.
In his mind, he had already decided to use the bead that he had picked up and missed at the Immortal Sun's auction that day.
He knew that there was a seal inside that bead, which was comparable to the full-strength attack of the Immortal King's Seventh Heavenly Power.
It should be no problem to help him escape...
The next moment, a black bead the size of an egg appeared out of thin air in Lin Xuan's hand.
